events.verdict: Turner (POR) briefly grasps Fournier's (ORL) jersey but does not affect his SQBR.
RAR shows Isaac (ORL) clears the lane, then is in the paint for less than three seconds before the shot is taken.
Some contact occurs to McCollum's (POR) arm as he sets the screen, but the contact is marginal.
Aminu (POR) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Turner (POR) makes marginal contact as he puts a forearm to Fournier's (ORL) front during his drive.
Fournier (ORL) makes incidental contact with Lillard's (POR) body during the follow-through on his shot near the rim.
McCollum (POR) sets the screen in Vucevic's (ORL) path and contact occurs to his arms, but the contact is marginal.
RAR shows Augustin (ORL) makes contact with the ball during Lillard's (POR) driving shot attempt.
Ross (ORL) sets the screen in Aminu's (POR) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Turner (POR) and Isaac (ORL) engage then disengage off-ball without affecting each other's FOM.
Nurkic (POR) makes marginal contact with Augustin (ORL) as he disengages from the contact.
Vucevic (ORL) makes marginal contact with Lillard (POR) during the drive that does not affect his SQBR.
Isaac (ORL) is in the paint and cleanses prior to three seconds.
Isaac (ORL) cleanly blocks Lillard's (POR) shot.
Vucevic (ORL) extends his arms into Lillard (POR) and dislodges him.
Isaac (ORL) is firming up in a legal screening position in McCollum's (POR) path when contact occurs and he absorbs contact.
Vucevic (ORL) moves laterally into Lillard's (POR) path in transition and affects his SQBR.
Vucevic (ORL) is not in a wide stance as he sets the screen in McCollum's (POR) path and he absorbs contact.
Vucevic (ORL) commits a take foul on Turner (POR).
Nurkic (POR) extends his arm into Isaac (ORL) and affects his ability to maintain his position.
Turner (POR) makes marginal contact with Simmons's (ORL) body that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Fournier (ORL) briefly grasps McCollum (POR) before correcting.
Augustin (ORL) commits a take foul on Turner (POR).
RAR shows Nurkic (POR) wraps Isaac (ORL) during the inbound.
McCollum (POR) briefly engages Fournier (ORL) with two hands but does not affect his SQBR.
Fournier (ORL) sets the screen in Aminu's (POR) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
